entities.summary: Orlando Octacílio Dotti is a Brazilian Catholic prelate, who served as Bishop of Caçador (1969–1976), Bishop of Barra (1976–1983), and Bishop of Vacaria (1986–2003). He is Bishop Emeritus of Vacaria.
